title: Architecture lane governance contract
outcomes: Consequential work cannot complete without traceability to an accepted governing architecture decision.

in: Architecture classification, claim preflight and finish conformance behavior
out: Mandating a newly authored ADR for every implementation task
boundaries: Task metadata, scoped briefs, decision ledger and architecture event stream

decision_rights: accept or revise governing architecture decisions and risks
propose options and verify conformance without claiming human authority

constraints: The existing .go/decisions/events.jsonl ledger remains the only decision source of truth.
Legacy repositories and none/local tasks remain backward compatible.
A task may reuse an existing accepted governing decision; the gate must not force duplicate ADRs.

quality_attributes.scenario: A task is effectively classified as material or foundational and reaches claim or finish preflight.
quality_attributes.measure: Material or foundational tasks with zero exact accepted governing decision references

risks: An overly literal gate could incentivize meaningless ADR creation instead of reuse of a real governing decision.
